dct_alternative_sm: Étude du potentiel de baignade le long de la rivière Chateauguay/Bathing potential assessment along the Chateauguay River
dct_description_sm: A study conducted in summer 2021 by Fondation Rivières validated the bathing potential of 9 sites along 55 km of the Châteauguay River. The bacteriological quality of the water was analyzed using both E. coli counts after laboratory culture and a new rapid analysis technology (ColiMinder, VWMS). This dataset contains all the E. coli count data after laboratory culture carried out as part of this project. /A study was conducted in the summer of 2021 by Rivers Foundation to validate the bathing potential of 9 sites along 55 km of the Châteauguay River. The bacteriological quality of the water was analyzed using both E. coli counts after incubation and a new rapid analysis technology (CoLimInder, VWMS). This dataset contains all of the E. coli counts after incubation perfomed during this project.

Une étude réalisée à l'été 2021 par Fondation Rivières a permis de valider le potentiel de baignade de 9 sites le long de 55 km de la rivière Châteauguay. La qualité bactériologique de l'eau a été analysée en recourant à la fois aux dénombrements d’E. coli après culture en laboratoire et à une nouvelle technologie d’analyse rapide (ColiMinder, VWMS). Ce jeu de données contient l'ensemble des données dénombrements d’E. coli après culture en laboratoire réalisés dans le cadre de ce projet./A study was conducted in the summer of 2021 by Rivers Foundation to validate the bathing potential of 9 sites along 55 km of the Châteauguay River. The bacteriological quality of the water was analyzed using both E. coli counts after incubation and a new rapid analysis technology (ColiMinder, VWMS). This dataset contains all of the E. coli counts after incubation perfomed during this project.
dct_title_s: Bathing potential assessment along the Chateauguay River
